settings.question: Do I need a prescription?
settings.answer: All items in this collection can be bought without a GP prescription. A small number of pharmacist-only medicines require you to answer a few questions before you can add the product to your basket, and our experienced pharmacists review this information before approving an order for processing and shipping.

settings.question: Are these genuine pharmacy products?
settings.answer: Yes — every product is sourced and dispatched from our registered Irish pharmacy and is the same stock carried in our stores.

settings.question: Can I get pharmacist advice before I buy?
settings.answer: You can. Contact our pharmacy team for help choosing a suitable product, checking interactions, or deciding whether to see your GP.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: We aim to ship all items within the same working day for orders placed before 3pm, Monday to Friday. Delivery is free on orders over €65, and Click & Collect is available at all seven of our stores.

settings.banner_text:
Our Medicines & Health range covers everyday healthcare for the whole family — from pain relief, hayfever and cold & flu remedies to heartburn, digestive care, vitamins and sexual health. It's home to trusted brands like Nurofen, Gaviscon, Cetrine and Nytol.

Everything here is dispatched from our registered Irish pharmacy, with pharmacist advice on hand whenever you need it.

settings.seo_heading: Shopping medicines & health online in Ireland
settings.seo_text: This is one of our largest health categories, bringing together over-the-counter medicines and everyday wellbeing essentials — from painkillers and allergy relief to digestive care, vitamins and self-care products. McCormack's Pharmacy is a registered Irish pharmacy, so anything you order is the same genuine product you'd find in our stores. A small number of pharmacist-only medicines, such as Viagra Connect, simply need a short online assessment reviewed by our pharmacist before they're supplied.
